name: S5ARC
summary: Multi-tenant e-commerce platform: launch online stores on custom subdomains, with admin dashboard built in.
description: An open-source e-commerce platform for launching stores quickly: each tenant runs its own store on a custom subdomain with isolated data, plus product management, cart, checkout and order tracking. Store owners get an admin dashboard for inventory, orders and settings; authentication uses Better Auth with email verification. Built with Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui, Drizzle ORM over PostgreSQL and Zod. AGPL-3.0 licensed, with a commercial licensing option.
contains: multi-tenancy: stores on custom subdomains with isolated data
full flow: products, cart, checkout and order tracking
admin dashboard for inventory, orders and store settings
Next.js 15 App Router, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4
Drizzle ORM over PostgreSQL, Zod validation, Better Auth
AGPL-3.0 with a commercial licensing option
